rules.name: RSA Public-Key Cryptography Detected
rules.threat_model: Vulnerable to polynomial-time factorization via Shor's Algorithm
rules.nist_migration: FIPS 203 (ML-KEM) for KEM or FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) for Signatures

rules.name: Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECDSA / ECDH / Ed25519)
rules.threat_model: Broken by discrete logarithm resolution on quantum processors

rules.name: Symmetric Encryption Bit-Strength Degradation (AES-128)
rules.threat_model: Grover's Algorithm reduces effective security strength to ~64 bits
rules.nist_migration: Upgrade key length to AES-256 (provides 128-bit post-quantum security)

rules.name: Legacy Cryptographic Hash (SHA-1 / MD5 / SHA-256 Collisions)
rules.threat_model: Pre-image attack complexity halved under quantum search operators
rules.nist_migration: Migrate to SHA-384, SHA-512, or SHA3-256/512
